messages:
Samir Patel: Quick ask from FinRegCo: POC must be EU-only. They want subprocessor list scoped to Frankfurt, assurance no egress to APAC/US, and KMS keys in EU. Demo next Wed.

Mia Chen: Can we run hosted reserved capacity pinned to eu-central-1 or do they require Private?

Samir Patel: Hosted is preferred for speed but compliance says no cross-border egress. They also want explicit SSO/observability subprocessors listed.

Jordan Lee: We can tenant-pin to eu-central-1. Failover policy can be EU-only. Note: control plane telemetry defaults to us-west2 unless we enable EU control plane for the tenant.

Ana Gomez: Legal keeps an EU-only subproc manifest for customers who sign the EU addendum. I can pull it but need sign-off.

Evan Brooks: Cost note: enabling EU pin + EU control plane ~= +12% infra for the short POC. BYOK (customer KMS in EU) is a one-off enable (~2 infra days + 1 security review).

Mia Chen: Action items: Jordan verify pinned capacity SLA (1-week POC), Evan finalize cost delta & BYOK estimate, Ana fetch signed subproc manifest and EU addendum. Ill draft reply once we have these.

OpsBot: created task #498: tenant-pin-eu POC (owner: Jordan Lee).

Jordan Lee: I can provision the pinned pool in ~48h once approved.

Samir Patel: Please confirm BYOK timing and subproc list by EOD so I can answer the prospect. Thanks.
